summary: Backend-only testing for the new Team Calendar endpoints (GET /api/calendar/team-members and GET /api/calendar/team). Wrote pytest suite covering all 9 scenarios from the review request: owner + sub-user team-members listing (auth, is_me/is_owner flags, color, sorting), team calendar visibility for both roles with the critical privacy redaction check, user_ids filter, foreign user_id silent-drop, area filter, and auth guard. 8/9 tests PASSED. 1 real backend bug found: when 'user_ids' filter is provided and NONE of the requested ids belong to the tenant, the endpoint returns ALL tenant events instead of an empty list (privacy/behavior deviation from spec). Fix is a one-liner in /app/backend/server.py. Everything else works correctly: privacy redaction (location/notes/contact_id/phone_* + read_only=true) is applied properly for both owner->sub and sub->owner directions; team-members list is deterministic-colored and sorted (me → owner → alpha); auth is enforced (401/403 without token); area filter and single-user filter work as expected.

minor.issue: When user_ids contains ONLY user_ids that are NOT part of the tenant, the filter is silently dropped and all tenant events are returned (spec says empty list). Root cause: server.py lines 1910-1914 skip 'q["created_by"] = {"$in": allowed_ids}' when allowed_ids is empty, causing the filter to have no effect at all. Fix: remove the 'if allowed_ids:' guard, so the query becomes '$in: []' → 0 results. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:1910-1914

action_items: Fix /api/calendar/team foreign-user_ids filter: in server.py ~line 1913 remove the 'if allowed_ids:' guard so the $in filter is always applied when the caller sends user_ids (empty list → 0 results, no leakage of the whole tenant calendar). One-line change.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint code is clean, well-commented, and correctly implements the privacy redaction (empty strings + contact_id=null + read_only=true for non-owned events).
Deterministic color hash (_color_for_user) is stable and returns valid #RRGGBB from a 12-color palette.
Sorting logic (me → owner → alphabetical) works correctly for both owner and sub-user callers.
Minor: the 'if allowed_ids:' guard should be dropped to honor the 'silently return empty' requirement for foreign user_ids.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test appointments via /api/appointments (title OWNER_APPT_TEST + SUBUSER_APPT_TEST); both are deleted by fixture teardown. No orphan data left in DB.

rca_of_issue: Bug: /api/calendar/team with user_ids=<all-foreign-ids> returns full tenant calendar instead of []. RCA: server.py lines 1910-1914 wrap the $in filter in 'if allowed_ids:', so when the intersection with tenant_ids is empty the filter is skipped and the base query {'user_id': tid} returns everything. Reproduction: as owner, GET /api/calendar/team?start=...&end=...&user_ids=fakeuser_xyz → 2 items returned. Expected: 0 items. Mitigation: apply the $in filter unconditionally whenever user_ids param is provided; empty allowed_ids → $in:[] → Mongo returns 0 documents.
